outcomeNote: Mishna only; the tanna kamma and Rabbi Yehuda dispute the twenty-cubit limit with no resolution here

segments.he: סוּכָּה שֶׁהִיא גְּבוֹהָה לְמַעְלָה מֵעֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה — פְּסוּלָה. וְרַבִּי יְהוּדָה מַכְשִׁיר.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «A sukka,» i.e., its roofing, which is the main and most crucial element of the mitzva, «that is more than twenty cubits high is unfit. Rabbi Yehuda deems it fit.»

segments.he: וְשֶׁאֵינָהּ גְּבוֹהָה עֲשָׂרָה טְפָחִים, וְשֶׁאֵין לָהּ (שְׁלֹשָׁה) דְּפָנוֹת, וְשֶׁחֲמָתָהּ מְרוּבָּה מְצִלָּתָהּ — פְּסוּלָה.
segments.en: Similarly, a sukka «that is not» even «ten handbreadths high, and» one «that does not have three walls, and» one «whose sunlight» that passes through its roofing «is greater than its shade are unfit.»
